comment: Bad teacher. Made us write multiple drafts for no reason. Didn't receive any papers back until it was too late to do anything. Her grading system is whacked out and she looks for ways to give you a lower grade. Don't take her, you'll regret it
She is super super nice... But, a really hard grader... It's possible to get an A, but I'd say that's mostly for kids who are already fairly good writers.
not bad, the class is easy but she doesnt give out many "A's."

This class was an atrocious experience because she never handed papers back and then she dished out grades without explaination.  What kind of a writing class does not provide for feedback from the professor?

Mrs. Adams is a very nice lady. She's also very patient and helpful outside of class. I thought she did a nice job of teaching the class, although it did get quite boring at times. But overall, she made english (a subject which I despise) bearable, and even interesting every now and then. Also, she gave no final. I would recommend her.
